title: Own your tensors
hints: Separate values from derivatives.
A scalar is a zero-dimensional array, not a length-one vector.
Copy the data and allocate independent zero gradient storage.

title: Undo broadcasting
hints: Reverse replication with addition.
Handle extra leading axes first.
Retain singleton dimensions when reducing axes from the original shape.

title: Order a shared graph
hints: Track node identity.
Visit parents before appending their child.
Repeated edges do not mean repeated traversal.

title: Run reverse mode
hints: Initialize gradients before callbacks run.
The output seed is itself a gradient.
Reverse the topological list exactly once.

title: Differentiate addition
hints: Use unbroadcast for each parent.
Callbacks add contributions.
Do not deduplicate operand contributions.

title: Differentiate multiplication
hints: Hold the other operand fixed.
Multiply by the upstream gradient first.
Reduce to the parent shape after multiplying.

title: Differentiate matrix products
hints: Write the index equation for the forward result.
Check that the inner dimension contracts.
The two gradients use the opposite operand transposed.

title: Differentiate reductions
hints: Remember which axis was reduced.
Restore the axis only when it was removed.
Broadcast the upstream values to the input shape.

title: Introduce a nonlinearity
hints: Save or recover the active mask.
The output and derivative use related but different values.
Zero belongs to the inactive side by contract.

title: Compose exponential and logarithm
hints: Use the output of exp in its local derivative.
The log derivative uses the input reciprocal.
Multiply every local derivative by the upstream gradient.

title: Construct a loss from operations
hints: Build subtraction from addition and multiplication.
Square a shared intermediate.
Normalize by the number of elements after broadcasting.

title: Stabilize cross-entropy
hints: Softmax ignores a common shift.
Compute the normalizer after subtracting the row maximum.
Each gradient row should sum approximately to zero.

title: Update shared parameters once
hints: Use object identity for optimizer membership.
Apply the gradient before clearing it.
A repeated parameter is one storage location.

title: Train a composed network
hints: Construct the forward expression from earlier operations.
Record the pre-update scalar loss.
Differentiate and update once per step.
